summary: RETEST of the 3 critical regressions from iteration_123. ALL THREE FIXES VERIFIED. (1) Admin /admin/taxi-booking-config now renders [data-testid=admin-service-taxi_booking] with 4 settings (unified_flow toggle, whatsapp_enabled toggle, whatsapp_number text input pre-filled with 596696112233, and config-whatsapp_message_template TEXTAREA). Save click produces success toast. Placeholder gone. (2) All mode-specific panels render correctly via direct URL: panel-flight, panel-pets, panel-assist, panel-corporate, panel-contact, panel-bidding — no more shadowing by panel-schedule. (3) Home tiles (CMS hcat_*) now land on ride-choose-page via /course?mode=X (verified VTC → /course?mode=intercity and Programmer → /course?mode=book_later). taxi-hub-page never visible after click. (Regression) /course?mode=standard end-to-end still works: Google Places autocomplete → choose-ride-section with live prices → ride-choose-whatsapp-btn visible (green WhatsApp) and ride-choose-request-btn shows '13.65 €'.
passing_checks: Settings: unified_flow_enabled (toggle ON), whatsapp_enabled (toggle ON), whatsapp_number input pre-filled '596696112233', whatsapp_message_template TEXTAREA (config-whatsapp_message_template testid present)
rider login → /course?mode=airport renders panel-flight + panel-flight-input AND a separate panel-schedule (sibling, expected)
/course?mode=standard: Tour Eiffel + Gare du Nord autocompleted via .pac-item; choose-ride-section appears; ride-choose-whatsapp-btn visible; ride-choose-request-btn 'Commander · 13.65 €'
critical_code_review_comments: MINOR (testability): AdminServiceConfig.js applies data-testid='config-<key>' ONLY on the textarea branch (line 244). Toggle/number/text inputs don't get the testid. The spec requires it only for config-whatsapp_message_template, but adding data-testid to ALL setting inputs (toggle, number, text) would improve E2E test reliability and prevent future selector-by-label fragility.
MINOR: 'Sauvegarder' button has no data-testid; consider adding data-testid='admin-service-config-save' for testability.

RideChoosePage.js is now 660+ lines after the ModePanel split — recommend extracting panel components into /pages/user/ridechoose/panels/ folder and a useRideChooseState() hook in a follow-up refactor.
seed_data_creation: None new; only edited & restored WhatsApp number to 596696112233 in admin config (idempotent).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 regressions from iteration_123 are resolved. Login flow on mobile viewport requires clicking 'Ou choisir une autre option de connexion' then the 'email & mot de passe' button before email/password inputs are shown — direct fill on /login times out otherwise. Admin /admin/taxi-booking-config now functional. Home tiles are CMS-driven (hcat_*) but TaxiHubPage redirect ensures the unified flow is always entered. Suggested follow-up (low priority): add data-testid to all AdminServiceConfig inputs and to the Save button.
rca of the issue: Confirmed root causes from iteration_123 (already fixed by main agent): (1) AdminServiceConfig.js serviceConfigs map now contains taxi_booking entry with 4 settings including textarea type; (2) RideChoosePage.js ModePanel split into ModeSpecificPanel + SchedulePanel rendered as siblings, eliminating the early-return shadowing; (3) TaxiHubPage.js detects ?mode= and unified_flow_enabled then redirects to /course?mode=, transient guard taxi-hub-redirecting prevents flash.
